checks: two actual web connections concurrently retry one question without duplicate thread or message
changed retries, cross-case reads and foreign thread replies are refused
web role has no support queue or owner reply authority
owner reply is idempotent, visible to its customer and omits internal actor identity
stale owner action cannot overwrite a newer conversation
customer reply reopens the same owner queue thread and preserves priority/history
support actions do not change case or payment status
scope: Actual web/operations roles and scoped synthetic cases; owner HTTP identity check has separate local tests. No email or professional approval.
